townGuide.headline: Bagillt: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Bagillt offers Abbey Farm Museum, Greenfield Valley Museum, Greenfield Valley Rail and Steam Museum within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Abbey Farm Museum
